title: analytics.upload_click_conversion
description: Report one offline click conversion back to Google Ads. Durable before delivery (ConversionUpload) and idempotent on (click_id, conversion_action, conversion_at). clicked_at is optional but load-bearing: Google's 90-day window is measured from the click, so without it the module can only fall back to now - conversion_at, which is a strictly weaker test.
